source_provenance: R59 soup: r58_dir2p_true + 0.10 * (r58_si_v2_e6 - r58_dir2p_true); no new training, a convex combination of two working self-imitation checkpoints

norm.note: the graph input x is the RAW v7 decision vector; normalization is INSIDE the graph (std_eps = std + epsilon, float32)

onnx.graph: Sub(mean) -> Div(std+eps) -> Gemm(W1,b1) -> Relu -> Gemm(W2,b2) -> logits; ArgMax(axis=1, first-max) -> action_idx

boundary_disclosure: the ONNX graph covers the decision function ONLY (normalize+MLP+argmax); the perception state machine (BirdObserverV7, GapTrackerV7, since_flap/flap_run/last_gc/since_gap) is pure numpy frame processing in the host (ps1play/learn/visual_only.py Brain._vector) and carries no learned weights
